g.text: Submit contact / guest count / date change
Verify reference and code; rate-limit attempts
Find reference and stored code hash
Verify staff session and Receptionist role
Read Confirmed status, original dates and version
Validate fields, guest capacity and change policy
[Invalid input, late date change or no inventory]
Calculate revised JOD total and difference
BEGIN; lock booking and affected nightly inventory
Recheck version, status, cutoff and capacity
Return updated booking (same reference and code)
A date change atomically releases old nights and consumes new nights.
A failed change must preserve the original reservation.
